utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive still needs tools, basic supplies, and a few volunteers to sort donations. Want me to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hana can help, and she’s bringing tools and paint. I’ll let her know we still need a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara. Could you check the west gate hinge and the porch light by the repair drive? Sam can help with both.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check the west gate hinge and the porch light.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can bring the wrench and a few tools by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I might still need that wrench tomorrow, and I can help catch up on the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can help with that. Let’s line up the repair drive stuff for this week.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’m in too. I’ll help get the repair drive stuff lined up this week.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, then we’re set for this week. I’ll help line up the repair drive stuff with you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep track of the supplies and make sure the repair drive is covered.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm Sam and Bo are definitely helping with it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t confirmed that yet, but Rosa has the list ready and I’ll check on Sam and Bo right now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m sending a quick invite to everyone on my block tonight, and I’ll make sure Mara gets the fixing list too. Saturday’s the day, and Uli will be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll spread the word tonight so everyone on my block knows Saturday is the day, and I’ll keep Mara’s fixing list ready for her.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I’ll bring the patch list and a few screws.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks. I’ll check with Tess after lunch so we know who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Right. Noah has pickup and Rosa has the rest, so we should be covered.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and check who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. I’ll keep track of the tools and paint, and we can make sure enough hands show up for the patching.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll keep checking for anyone who still needs a hand and let Opal know too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Rey. Leo’s bringing the patch list and a few screws, so we’re set to get started.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, and I heard Ira can help once he finishes his errands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, then we should be ready to cover everything once Ira wraps up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around after lunch and see who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there on Saturday. Quinn’s sending the invite tonight, so everyone on the block should know by then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that should help. I’ll still ask around after lunch and see who needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can cover the plumbing parts and a couple of switches. Do we have a posted list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I’ve got the drive ready. Gus is bringing the tools, and I’ll make sure the list is posted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, then I’ll wait for the posted list and check what Ira still needs to fill in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help after 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll check the repair drive list and sort out what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, I’ll keep it in mind.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll send a quick invite to everyone on my block tonight, and Uli’s already in. Mara’s set too, and I’ll get her the fixing list so she can handle her part.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm Sam and Bo are on the repair drive list too?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can check with them tonight and make sure Sam and Bo are on the list too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by after my errands and stay a bit if you still need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That would help a lot - Oren and I are already on the repair drive, and Cleo's got the supplies counted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I can help with that after I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The drive is ready on my end, and Gus has the tools. We can head over when you’re set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Ira can join once they’re back from errands. I’ll wait here until then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. I’ll stay put until Ira gets back, then we can all head over together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I remember the repair drive needs tools, paint, and a few hands for the patching. Do we have enough of each before we start?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We should be okay on hands once Bo arrives after 3:30, but I still want to double-check the tools and paint.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good, then let’s check the tools and paint now so we know exactly what still needs filling in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive still needs tools, basic supplies, and a few volunteers to sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help after 3:30, and I can probably bring a couple tools too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That would help a lot. I’ll let the others know we’ve got another volunteer and a couple more tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can spread the word and check who still needs a hand, and I’ll make sure Opal gets the updates.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hana can bring tools and paint, so we’ve got that covered. I’ll swing by and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, then I’ll keep checking for anyone else who still needs a hand and pass the updates to Opal.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can help catch up on the repair drive. Did Gus still have that wrench?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven't heard back on the wrench yet. Tess said she'd ask around after lunch, so let's wait for that before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll wait on Tess and not count on the wrench yet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The west gate hinge is loose, and the porch light by the repair drive is flickering. Sam can help with both.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Right, I’ve got the patch list and a few screws. Noah can handle pickup, and Rosa has the rest ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Noah can take pickup, and Rosa’s got the rest ready. I’ll keep Sam lined up for the hinge and porch light.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I’ll be there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll check the repair drive list and make sure Opal’s hinge and porch light are covered.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. Quinn’s got the invites, so that should cover the block.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around after lunch and see who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can cover plumbing parts and a couple of switches. If Nell sees a posted list, have her point me to it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll check around after lunch and send Nell your way if I find the posted list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can help with that. I’ll check with Vik and line up the repair drive stuff this week.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, I’ll keep track of the supplies and make sure the repair drive is covered.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll touch base with Vik and get the repair drive details lined up this week.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can bring a few tools and lend a wrench. I’ll have them over by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make sure the drive has what it needs by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll bring the tools by tomorrow morning and make sure the wrench is ready too.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
